CREATE PROC [OM].[SP_SRC_CHECK] @task_name [varchar](100),@process_date [datetime] AS
BEGIN
S
    DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
    DECLARE @ME_FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0)
	
	SELECT  
		@ME_FLAG_CNT=COUNT(*)  
	FROM 
		[EDS].[DATE_DIM] 
	WHERE 
		FULLDATE=@process_date 
		AND COALESCE(MONTH_END,'N')='Y'

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASKS WHERE TASK_NAME IN (
select TASK_NAME from om.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY where dependent_task_name like '%Customer_dim%') AND TASK_NAME = 'TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS'

select datesk,fulldate,business_day_flag,previous_business_day, * from eds.date_dim where datesk between 20240327 and 20240402 order by 1

select * from om.om_task_run where process_date = '2024-03-27'

insert into om.om_task_run
select 'task-run-test',task_name,'task-run-test',3,'eds','2024-03-27', '2024-07-23','2024-07-23','2024-07-23',null from om.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY where dependent_task_name like '%Customer_dim%'

update  om.om_task_run set process_date = '2024-03-30' where process_date = '2024-03-29' and task_name IN ( 'TSK_EDS_MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB','TSK_EDS_RIB_CUSTOMERLOCATION','TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS')

update  om.om_task_run set process_date = '2024-03-27' where process_date = '2024-03-26' and task_name IN ( 'TSK_EDS_CRM_ADDRESS')

select * from om.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY

alter table om.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY
add ISMAIN VARCHAR(1)

SELECT * FROM OM.OM_TASKS WHERE TASK_NAME= 'TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS'

UPDATE om.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY SET ISMAIN = 'Y' WHERE  dependent_task_name like '%Customer_dim%' AND TASK_NAME = 'TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS'

UPDATE OM.OM_TASKS SET FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'DAILY' WHERE TASK_NAME = 'TSK_STG_EDS_CRM_ACCOUNTS'



DECLARE @FLAG_CNT [NUMERIC](15,0), @process_date  date, @task_name varchar(100)
set @process_date = '2024-03-30'
set @task_name = 'TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM'

IF((SELECT COUNT(1) FROM OM.OM_TASKS OT 
	INNER JOIN OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD 
	ON OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = @task_name 
	AND OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME 
	WHERE OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'DAILY' AND OTD.ISMAIN = 'Y' )>0 AND (SELECT * FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE FULLDATE =  @process_date AND BUSINESS_DAY_FLAG = 'N')>0 )
	
	--SELECT 'Y'

	
    SELECT
	@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
	

	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	INNER JOIN
		[EDS].[DATE_DIM] EDD
		ON
		FULLDATE =  @process_date
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASKS] OT
		ON
		OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
		CASE WHEN OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING = 'DAILY' THEN EDD.FULLDATE
			 ELSE EDD.PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY END = OTR.PROCESS_DATE
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
		AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME


ELSE

    SELECT
	@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
	FROM 
		[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
		ON
		OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
		OTR.PROCESS_DATE =  @process_date
	LEFT JOIN
		[OM].[OM_TASKS] OT
		ON
		OT.TASK_NAME = OTD.TASK_NAME
	LEFT JOIN   
		[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
		ON
		OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
	WHERE
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
		AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')<>'Y'
	GROUP BY
		OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME

SELECT @FLAG_CNT

	 
	IF(@FLAG_CNT<>1)   
		BEGIN
			DECLARE @errmsg1 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' SOURCES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN TABLE FOR LIST OF SOURCES THAT ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE';   
	  
			THROW 80000, @errmsg1, 1;  
		END
		
	IF(@ME_FLAG_CNT>0)   
		BEGIN
			SELECT
			@FLAG_CNT=(CASE WHEN COUNT(*) <> SUM(COALESCE((CASE WHEN OS.STATUS = 'SUCCESSFUL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END)
			
			FROM 
				[OM].[OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY] OTD
			LEFT JOIN
				[OM].[OM_TASK_RUN] OTR
				ON
				OTD.TASK_NAME =  OTR.TASK_NAME AND
				OTR.PROCESS_DATE = @process_date
			LEFT JOIN   
				[OM].[OM_STATUS] OS
				ON
				OTR.STATUS_ID =  OS.STATUS_ID
			WHERE
				OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME = UPPER(@task_name)
				AND COALESCE(OTD.MONTHEND,'N')='Y'
			GROUP BY
				OTD.DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME
		
				IF(@FLAG_CNT<>1)   
				BEGIN
					DECLARE @errmsg2 NVARCHAR(2048) = 'JOB '+@task_name+' SOURCES ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE, PLEASE CHECK OM.OM_TASK_RUN TABLE FOR LIST OF SOURCES THAT ARE NOT YET AVAILABLE';   
			  
					THROW 80000, @errmsg2, 1;  
				END
		END	

END
GO
